theorems.name: Submission.dgcr_smooth_tests_to_C1_tests
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (D : Set (Euclid n)) (G : Euclid n → ℝ), IsOpen D → LocallyIntegrableOn G D volume → (∀ a : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) a → HasCompactSupport a → tsupport a ⊆ D → ∀ j : Fin n, ∫ v in D, G v * fderiv ℝ a v (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)) = 0) → ∀ φ : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ D → ∀ i : Fin n, ∫ x, G x * fderiv ℝ φ x ((EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ) i) = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
